actions.note: Resolved ticket #4821: duplicate invoice emails traced to a retry bug in billing notification job; fixed and confirmed no further duplicates sent.
Resolved ticket #4822: password reset loop caused by expired session token validation bug; patched token refresh logic and verified reset flow works end-to-end.
Resolved ticket #4823: export job stuck due to a deadlocked worker process; cleared the stuck job and restarted the queue worker, confirmed exports now process normally.
Resolved ticket #4824: mailing list bounce backlog caused by misconfigured SMTP retry settings; corrected config and cleared the backlog, confirmed bounces now process correctly.
Resolved ticket #4825: stale cache on pricing page caused by CDN cache TTL misconfiguration; purged cache and adjusted TTL settings, verified pricing page now reflects current data.
Resolved ticket #4826: broken link in onboarding doc updated to point to the current help center article; verified link works correctly.

Resolved ticket #4827: timezone mismatch in report footer fixed by aligning footer timestamp generation with user's configured timezone instead of server default; verified reports now display correct local time.
Resolved ticket #4828: attachment size error caused by outdated max-upload-size config on the form handler; increased limit to match documented policy and verified uploads now succeed.
